# Milestone Zero / Milepost Zero Guide: All offers and upgrades

![Milestone Zero / Milepost Zero Guide: All offers and upgrades](/uploads/407_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

**Attention:**Milestone zero, the caravans and quests have been completely removed. The plans are now in Highway Town with some dealers e.g. Windy, and available as a reward from the Holiday and Spooky Burnt Ones.

See: Milestone Zero Plans in Highway Town (Windy, V63 Laser Carbine and more)

Milepost Zero caravans are now available in the game. In the hotfix on September 17th, 2024, the caravans were unlocked and some errors (e.g. loot problem) were fixed. See also: Fallout 76: Milepost Zero Hotfix Patch Notes September 17, 2024

## Quest: "Stumbling Blocks"

This quest starts automatically as soon as you start Fallout 76 and enter a world. In the quest you look for clues at the Stony Man Lookout in Skyline Valley. To do this, you collect the holotape of the Blue Ridge employee who is lying dead in one of the cages.

The quest now takes you directly to Milestone Zero, the location in the south of Skyline Valley where you can manage your caravans.

![Milepost Zero](/uploads/nukaknights-posts-20240706084140-1-milepost-zero-map.jpg)

![Milestone Zero / Milepost Zero](/uploads/nukaknights-posts-20240706084311-1.jpg)

Here you enter the instance and meet Marley, who introduces you to the business of your caravan company. You can order and process deliveries from her. And you can also hire other employees from Marley: Josie the Brahmin tamer, Alex the decorator, Ineke the import dealer, Theodor the ammunition dealer and Windy the cryptid hunter.

Of course there is a new currency here: **Supplies**

For successful deliveries in "Caravan: Skyline Drive" events, you will receive 10, 25 or 50 supplies depending on the size of the delivery. You have to escort a Brahmin through an area similar to “free range”. The "Caravan: Skyline Drive" events are public events. Every other player can help you and will also receive supplies upon completion. You can then use the supplies to hire employees and traders and then upgrade them to higher levels. Each employee can be leveled up twice, each time offering additional goods, quests or other opportunities.

![Milepost Zero HQ](/uploads/nukaknights-posts-20240706084731-1.jpg)

Josie the Brahmin Tamer can give the Brahmins additional abilities, e.g. that they can run faster. Alex the Decorator can redecorate your Milepost Zero instance, and he can also find items for you (although he can also find bobbleheads and magazines), Ineke the Import Trader offers various blueprints (e.g. new outfits), **Theodore** offers you ammunition for sale and at level 2 he offers you a Vault 63 quest called "**Unconventional Weapons**" where you get the **V63 Laser Carbine Rifle**. At level 3, Theordore then offers you the mods for the rifle as a blueprint. So it's worth hiring Theodore first and upgrading him if you want the new rifle. *But be careful: There is a bug where you won't learn the weapon's blueprint through the quest if you've already gotten the weapon from someone. So you shouldn't have the V63 Laser Carbine in your inventory or stash when you do the quest.*

More about the V63 Laser Carbine on YouTube: New V63 Laser Carbine / Unique Overheat Feature & Tests

## Skyline Drive Events: Earn Supplies

*Tip: Carry a Medic weapon during deliveries to heal the Brahmin.*

You complete the first delivery within the “Stumbling Blocks” quest. Here you will receive **100 supplies** upon completion. After that you have to make **2 more deliveries*
